name: Concrete CMS
description_en:
Concrete CMS is the current name of concrete5, a PHP/MySQL content management system with in-context block editing, permissions, versioning and editorial workflows. The software is available under MIT for self-hosting; the vendor also sells managed hosting where entry packages explicitly withhold source-code access. Those are different operating choices.

Evaluate content editing and ownership needs together. A designer/developer can build a custom installation, while a small team can choose managed SaaS with editor, storage and traffic allowances. An open-source core does not make every hosted plan, extension, support service or compliance claim free or independently verified.
description_zh:
Concrete CMS 是 concrete5 的现名，是提供页面内区块编辑、权限、版本及编辑工作流的 PHP/MySQL 内容管理系统。软件以 MIT 提供自托管，厂商也销售托管服务，入门套餐明确不提供源码访问，两者是不同运营方式。

应同时评估内容编辑和使用权需求。设计师/开发者可构建定制安装，小团队则可选择有编辑者、存储和流量限制的托管 SaaS。核心开源不意味着全部托管、扩展、支持免费，也不代表合规主张已独立验证。

core_features.explanation_en: Editors change blocks on the page and distinguish Save from Publish, with local versus global areas affecting different scopes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 编辑者在页面修改区块，并区分保存与发布，本地/全局区域影响范围不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Roles/groups, workflow and revision history support team content work, subject to the actual permission configuration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 角色/组、工作流和版本历史支持团队编辑，实际行为取决于权限配置。

core_features.explanation_en: Self-host the free source or select managed plans with restricted code access and explicit resource/editor limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可自托管免费源码，或选择限制源码访问、明确资源/编辑者额度的托管方案。

pricing.summary_en: Core MIT source free/self-hosted; managed Starter$4.99/month and Business$19 billed annually with editor/storage/traffic limits and no source access. Custom hosting/support/marketplace costs separate; checkout currency/tax unknown.
pricing.summary_zh: 核心 MIT源码免费自托管；托管 Starter年付月均$4.99、Business$19，有编辑者/存储/流量限制且无源码访问，定制托管/支持/市场另计，结账币种/税费未知。

sections.title_en: Use current documentation for the renamed product
sections.title_zh: 为更名产品使用当前文档
sections.en:
The original concrete5.org URL redirected to the current vendor site. Its July2021 rebrand announcement explicitly explains dropping “5” and separating the commercial .com presence from open-source/community .org resources. This record uses Concrete CMS while retaining the assigned legacy slug. The actual download page read lists9.5.7 released October20,2026, newer than the homepage’s October town-hall mention of9.5.5. Version/date here describe the source snapshot, not an installed or tested version.

Release source: [official download](https://www.concretecms.org/download).
sections.zh:
原 concrete5.org URL 跳转当前厂商站，2021年7月更名公告明确解释去掉“5”，并区分商业 .com 与开源/社区 .org。本记录使用 Concrete CMS，保留原分配 slug。实读下载页列9.5.7、2026年10月20日发布，比首页10月 town hall 提及9.5.5更新。版本/日期只是来源快照，不是已安装或测试版本。

版本来源：[官方下载](https://www.concretecms.org/download)。

sections.title_en: Distinguish saved drafts, publication and global reuse
sections.title_zh: 区分保存草稿、发布和全局复用
sections.en:
The current9.x user guide describes entering edit mode with the pencil, editing a block, then choosing Save Changes for editors, Publish Changes for the public version or Discard. Publication can be scheduled. Local areas affect one page; global areas affect every page using them. Clipboard copies create new block instances, while Stacks are reusable collections whose edits propagate wherever used. For a pilot, change a page paragraph and a shared footer separately, then verify author/viewer permissions and the public result. Some block controls require Advanced Permissions.

Procedure: [9.x edit-mode guide](https://documentation.concretecms.org/9-x/user-guide/edit-mode/general-concepts).
sections.zh:
当前9.x用户指南描述点击铅笔进入编辑、修改区块，再选 Save Changes 留给编辑者、Publish Changes 公开或 Discard 放弃，也可定时发布。本地区域只影响单页，全局区域影响所有使用页。Clipboard 复制产生新区块实例，Stacks 则为复用集合，修改会传播。试点可分别改页面段落和共享页脚，再验证作者/访客权限及公开结果，部分区块控制要求 Advanced Permissions。

操作依据：[9.x编辑指南](https://documentation.concretecms.org/9-x/user-guide/edit-mode/general-concepts)。

sections.title_en: Compare managed packages with own-source operation
sections.title_zh: 比较托管套餐与自行管理源码
sections.en:
Managed Starter displays$4.99/month billed annually with one site editor,2GB and10,000 page views/month. Business displays$19 on the same basis with five editors,20GB and50,000 page views/month, plus listed CDN/SSL/DDoS services. Both say no source access, managed upgrades, configuration support and nightly backups. A custom SLA engagement adds code/deployment/staging options and is separately quoted. Currency code,tax,overage,backup retention and extension eligibility need confirmation. The9.x hosting guide says SaaS supports a smaller curated extension set and cannot build custom themes/add-ons, whereas a self-hosted source installation gives control with operating responsibility.

Hosting model: [9.x installing/hosting](https://documentation.concretecms.org/9-x/user-guide/getting-started/install).
sections.zh:
托管 Starter 显示年付月均$4.99，含一名站点编辑者、2GB和每月10,000浏览。Business 同样年付月均$19，含五编辑者、20GB和每月50,000浏览，并列 CDN/SSL/DDoS服务。两者均称无源码访问、托管升级、配置支持和每夜备份。自定义 SLA 项目另报价，增加源码/部署/暂存选项。币种代码、税费、超额、备份保留及扩展资格需确认。9.x托管指南称 SaaS 支持较小的精选扩展集，不能创建自定义主题/扩展；自托管源码提供控制，也承担运营责任。

模式依据：[9.x安装/托管](https://documentation.concretecms.org/9-x/user-guide/getting-started/install)。

sections.title_en: Keep MIT rights separate from hosting contracts
sections.title_zh: 将 MIT 权利与托管合同分开
sections.en:
The vendor identifies the core as MIT-licensed. The actual open-source notice grants use/modification/distribution subject to preserving the copyright/permission notice and disclaims warranty. That supports a permissive open-source classification for the software, not a waiver of separate hosting or marketplace terms. The same page says an unmodified installation periodically contacts project servers for update/community information and records some site information; assess that behavior for the intended environment. The recommended download route uses Composer, while PHP/MySQL hosting, patching, backups and extension compatibility remain your responsibility on a self-hosted setup.

License detail: [MIT notice and callback description](https://www.concretecms.org/open-source-license).
sections.zh:
厂商将核心标为 MIT，实际开源声明授予使用/修改/分发权，要求保留版权/许可说明并排除保证。这支持软件的宽松开源分类，不免除独立托管或市场条款。同页称未修改安装会定期联系项目服务器取得更新/社区信息，并记录部分站点信息，应按目标环境评估。下载页推荐 Composer，自托管时 PHP/MySQL 主机、补丁、备份和扩展兼容仍由团队负责。

许可细节：[MIT声明及回连说明](https://www.concretecms.org/open-source-license)。

sections.title_en: Choose a delivery model that preserves required control
sections.title_zh: 选择满足控制需求的交付方式
sections.en: Concrete CMS is a plausible option for a content team needing visual editing with granular permissions and developer extensibility. A small SaaS site should confirm editor/traffic/storage limits; a custom application should plan source access, database/files recovery and deployment ownership. Avoid treating broad security/compliance badges as proof that any self-hosted installation or entry SaaS package satisfies a specific requirement. The old generic installation article read explicitly labels itself noncurrent; its permission/command examples were not copied as current setup advice. No software, editing, workflow approval, security audit, export or restore was executed here.
sections.zh: 需要可视化编辑、细权限及开发扩展的内容团队可考虑 Concrete CMS。小型 SaaS 站应确认编辑者/流量/存储限制，定制应用则需规划源码访问、数据库/文件恢复和部署责任。不能将宽泛安全/合规标签当作任意自托管或入门 SaaS 满足特定要求的证明。实读旧通用安装文章明确标为非当前版本，其权限/命令未复制为当前设置建议。本次未执行软件、编辑、工作流批准、安全审计、导出或恢复。
